description: Karlsruhe Institute of Technology publishes two-dimensional images and three-dimensional light-field observations of refuse-derived fuel particles in an industrial rotary kiln. The benchmark contains fifty manually labelled frames with particle coordinates and class masks, plus a full sequence of 2,010 images and associated point clouds. Labels distinguish burning and non-burning particles in the air or on the kiln wall. Zenodo supplies the observations and MATLAB visualisation examples under CC BY 4.0 for free reuse. These site-specific data can validate particle-detection or combustion-observation models supporting industrial process simulations. Bright particles and difficult kiln conditions introduce depth uncertainty, and the selected labelled frames cover only part of the sequence. Payload quality was not tested. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: Benchmark Dataset (2D/3D) of an Industrial Rotary Kiln Combustion Chamber with Refuse-Derived Fuel Particles from a Light-Field-Camera
notes: G4-0460; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
